I can't give medical advice or judge whether a device is safe for you. If this is an emergency, call 911 or your local emergency number. Please talk to your doctor or another qualified health professional about your situation. If you think a device has harmed someone, you can report it to the FDA through MedWatch. I can share what FDA reports and recalls say about a device, for example how many reports it has or whether it has been recalled.

**AcmeAir CPAP** (Example Medical Inc.): 1,234 reports linked by UDI in FDA MAUDE (2021–2025).

**Reports by event type:** 3 deaths, 120 injuries and 1,111 malfunctions.
Reports per year (latest 5 years with reports): 2021: 180, 2022: 260, 2023: 310, 2024: 280, 2025: 204.

MAUDE reports are sent in by manufacturers, health professionals and patients. A report does not prove that the device caused the event, and report counts are not failure rates.
Reports without a UDI are not linked to a device, so the real number can be higher.
**Sources:** FDA MAUDE and GUDID, FDA MAUDE reports, MAUDE problem codes, FDA recalls and enforcement (BigQuery, data as of 2026-11-08).
